items.title: Configuration-first
items.body: Forms, validation, and layout live in JSON consumed by @webkitfxv2/core-engine.

items.title: Roadmap
items.body: Same shell supports groceries and gas-cylinder distribution — swap form packs per vertical.

items.title: Guests welcome

login.title: Login
login.ribbon: Trusted supplier & shopper portal · Configuration-driven screens (demo)
login.lede: Sign in with the verified email and password for your account. Your role (shopper or vendor) is determined from that account — not chosen here.

enterprise.headline: Run sarees today, groceries and LPG tomorrow on one rails
enterprise.intro: Operators are consolidating storefronts, dark stores, and route logistics onto unified order and identity stacks. SareeCart is built as configuration-first commerce so you can swap vertical packs without rewriting screens — ideal when categories expand from high-touch apparel to repeat grocery baskets and regulated cylinder fulfilment.

trends.title: Omnichannel truth, not slides
trends.body: Buyers research on mobile, pay with UPI, and expect the same profile whether they checkout as a guest or sign in later. Your stack should treat identity and consent as shared services.

trends.title: Quick commerce discipline
trends.body: SLA-driven fulfilment windows, cut-offs, and exception handling are table stakes. JSON-driven forms let you tune capture fields per city or hub without redeploying the host app.

trends.title: Trust & verification
trends.body: GST-linked vendors, KYC-light shoppers, and auditable contact roles reduce chargebacks and failed deliveries — capture them once at onboarding, re-use everywhere.

enterprise.footerNote: Roadmap: plug grocery catalogues and LPG subscription cycles into the same shell — business rules stay in JSON packs per vertical.

vendorSignup.title: Vendor registration
vendorSignup.lede: Create portal credentials first (login name + password), then business, GST, address, and contact rows — those credentials are what you will use on Sign in.

shopperSignup.title: Shopper profile
shopperSignup.lede: Set portal login name and password, then profile and delivery details — reuse them on Sign in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Preference screens will be driven by JSON packs per vertical (sarees, groceries, LPG) — wire forms here the same way as signup.

support.title: Help centre
support.body: Support content and ticketing will load from your operations JSON — no hardcoded FAQs in the app bundle.

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy
legalPrivacy.body: Privacy policy text will be supplied as markdown or HTML from configuration per tenant.

legalTerms.title: Terms of use
legalTerms.body: Terms will be versioned in configuration alongside rollout of groceries and LPG modules.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.body: Cart line items and checkout will be driven by JSON order forms — this route is a placeholder until the basket pack is wired.

accountProfile.title: Your profile
accountProfile.body: Profile and identity details will load from your account pack — this screen is a placeholder.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.body: Saved items and lists will appear here once the catalogue pack is wired.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: Order history and tracking will load from your commerce services — this route is a placeholder.

communication.title: Communication
communication.body: Messages, alerts, and announcements will be driven from your notifications configuration — placeholder for now.
